google:*.label: Google Pixel (generic)
google:*.notes: Enable OEM unlocking in Developer Options first.

steps.label: Waiting for device (enable USB debugging, authorize this PC)
Magisk patch
instructions: 1. Download the factory image for this exact build from google.com/android/beta
2. Extract boot.img, copy to phone storage
3. In Magisk app on the phone: Install > Select boot.img > patch
5. Put its path in this recipe's fastboot_flash step, set auto_continue: true

samsung:*.label: Samsung (generic - Odin required)
warnings: Knox 0x0 -> 0x1 trips permanently. Banking apps may refuse to run.

steps.label: Waiting for device (enable USB debugging & OEM unlock)
Unlock via Download Mode
instructions: 1. Power off. Hold VolUp+VolDown and plug USB to enter Download Mode
2. Hold VolUp ~7s to open the unlock menu, confirm (WIPES DATA)
3. Device reboots. Complete setup WITHOUT adding Google/Samsung account

steps.label: Flash Magisk-patched AP via Odin
instructions: 1. Download matching firmware (Frija/SamFirm) for the PDA build shown in Device Info
2. Extract AP_x.tar.md5, patch with Magisk (app: Select AP file)
3. Odin: flash patched AP to AP slot, BL->BL, CP->CP, HOME_CSC->CSC (keeps data; CSC wipes)
4. After boot, factory-reset ONCE via recovery (Magisk requires it on Samsung)

steps.label: Waiting for boot to complete setup

xiaomi:*.label: Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO (Mi Unlock required)
warnings: Mi Unlock needs: Mi account on device, SIM with data, 168h (7 day) wait after binding.
fastboot flash is BLOCKED on Xiaomi stock - must unlock first.

steps.label: Mi Unlock tool
instructions: 1. Bind Mi account in Developer Options > Mi Unlock status
2. Boot to fastboot (VolDown+Power), run official Mi Unlock tool, unlock (WIPES DATA)
3. Wait the required 168 hours if the tool says so - there is no shortcut
4. After unlock: flash your Magisk-patched boot.img with fastboot

steps.label: Get OEM unlock code
instructions: 1. Get unlock data: fastboot oem get_unlock_data
2. Paste at motorola.com/unlockbootloader, receive unlock code by email
